description: Two overlapping radar shapes with a legend beneath that names each series.
overview: Two overlapping radar shapes with a legend underneath naming each series. Pick it over the plain multiple-series chart when readers need to know which shape is which without hovering.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the series keys in the data, both `Radar` elements and `chartConfig`; the legend reads labels and colors from the config. The series declared last is drawn on top.
